measurement: One size and one color, black with a printed Ossur logo. No body measurement is needed. Holds one knee brace, left or right, in any size. Not side specific, so the same bag fits a left or a right brace. Sized for full frame OA and unloader braces and fits most hinged, wraparound and OA knee braces. Full length post-op ROM braces and long leg immobilizers may not fit. The knee brace is not included. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
